sentences.Marit og Håvard har bodd sammen i fem år: Marit and Håvard have lived together for five years.
sentences.Marit synes at de sitter for mye i sofae: Marit thinks they sit on the sofa too much.
sentences.Skal vi begynne å trene på et treningsse: Shall we start working out at a gym, Håvard?
No, you're joking! You're absolutely perfect.
Thanks, but I've put on five kilos.
sentences.Jeg synes at det er deilig å slappe av e: I think it's lovely to relax after work.
sentences.Jeg synes at vi ser for mye på tv. Det e: I think we watch too much TV. It's unhealthy to sit still every evening, and I think it will be fun to work out together. We can do spinning, lift weights and go to group classes together.
sentences.Jeg synes at det er kjedelig å trene inn: I think it's boring to work out indoors. It's expensive too.
I think that's a poor excuse. We can work out outdoors. That's free.
sentences.Jeg trenger nye joggesko. Det er ikke bi: I need new running shoes. They aren't cheap.
sentences.Nå synes jeg at du er vanskelig. Vi bør: Now I think you're being difficult. We should keep fit instead of sitting in front of the TV every evening.
sentences.Hm... jeg skal tenke på det. Jeg skal ba: Hm... I'll think about it. I'm just going to relax a bit first.
sentences.Marit og Håvard sitter mye i sofaen hjem: Marit and Håvard sit on the sofa a lot at home.
sentences.Marit sier at hun har lagt på seg fem ki: Marit says that she has put on five kilos, and that she wants to start working out.
sentences.Håvard er ikke så interessert i trening,: Håvard isn't very interested in exercise, and he has lots of excuses.
sentences.Han sier at det er kjedelig og dyrt å tr: He says that it is boring and expensive to work out indoors, and that he needs new running shoes.
Marit thinks Håvard is being difficult.
Håvard says that he will think about it.
